title: Minutes for an infection to spread across a rack
insight: LeetCode 994 Rotting Oranges: multi-source breadth-first search from every infected cell, one BFS level per minute
prompt: Ops asked for a spread-time estimate for the outbreak simulator in this module. Implement SpreadTime in spread.go as specified in README.md; the README also has the grid format and the performance target. Don't change the package name or the exported signature, standard library only, and check that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` are clean.
